visualCharacteristics.purpose: Golden-ticket prize slider: a title, then one slide per prize (title, copy, rules link beside a prize image) with dot pagination.

contentPattern.structure: Rows holding a picture = a slide (picture cell = media; heading = title, CTA paragraphs = links, other paragraphs = body); any other row = slider title.

usage: Prize showcase in a promotion page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse promo-prizes wherever the same content pattern appears; authored content is moved into the block's layout, so keep the structure above.
